stage: end-to-end public workspace within current authorization boundary
scope: A privacy-first post-birth bureaucracy workspace that real people can use today for personalized prioritization, reusable encrypted local data, application preparation, evidence tracking, generated text-form actions and official handoffs. It does not impersonate an authority or claim submission rights that are not available.

capabilities: one guide intake for factors that materially change the post-birth plan
Germany-wide core journey with Berlin-specific birth-registration guidance
personalized next-action ordering for Kindergeld, Elterngeld, health insurance, maternity benefit, paternity, joint custody and parental leave
date-aware urgency without inventing false precision where the official rule is expressed in working days
current official-source routing including the August 2026 Elterngeld service transition
optional encrypted local family-data vault using PBKDF2-SHA256 and AES-GCM
reusable canonical data mapped into multiple service-specific application packets
copy-ready prepared fields before opening an official service
deduplicated evidence checklist across all relevant services
complete generated Elternzeit text-form notice when required inputs are present
clean public share link that does not include family data
no project account and no project backend receiving family answers

automationBoundary.reason: Those final actions require official identity/authority and interfaces that this independent public site does not possess.

modeledBenchmark.warning: The companion now removes search, coordination and repeated preparation work, but authoritative submissions remain external. National outcome reductions are therefore still architecture targets, not measured production impact.

whatIsActuallySolvedNow: A real parent can turn one situation intake into a smaller, ordered personal action plan instead of coordinating an undifferentiated checklist.
The same optional family data can be entered once and reused across several application-preparation packets instead of being retyped from scratch inside the companion.
The workspace keeps next action, progress and required evidence in one place.
For a text-form process the product controls, Elternzeit, the workspace can generate the finished notice rather than stopping at advice.
Official submissions are handed off transparently rather than simulated.
Sensitive optional data is encrypted locally and not sent to a project backend.
remainingExternalBoundary: verified identity/attributes through authorized BundID/EUDI integrations
once-only evidence retrieval through NOOTS/register interfaces
authorized submission APIs for benefits and registrations
qualified production privacy/security/legal review and public-sector partnership
doesNotProve: coverage of every German family configuration
nextEvidence: Use this version with real parents and measure task-finding time, repeat entry avoided, incorrect/missing tasks, successful official handoffs, confidence and completion. In parallel, connect the first authorized sandbox/public interface that removes a measured remaining handoff rather than adding another mock integration.
